filters.folderId = requireUuid(folderId);\n  }\n  if (tagId) {\n    filters.tagId = requireUuid(tagId);\n  }\n  if (from) {\n    filters.from = parseDateParam(from);\n  }\n  if (to) {\n    filters.to position: number;\n  note_count: number;\n}\n\nconst FOLDER_SELECT = `\n  SELECT f.id, f.parent_id, f.name, f.position,\n         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM notes n\n           WHERE n.folder_id = f.id AND n.user_id = f.user_id AND n.trashed_at IS NULL) AS note_count\n    FROM folders f`;\n\nfunction mapFolder(row: FolderRow) {\n  return {\n    id: row.id,\n    parentId: row.parent_id,\n    name: row.name,\n    position: row.position,\n    noteCount: row.note_count,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction cleanName(value: unknown): string {\n  if (typeof value !== 'string') {\n    throw badRequest('Enter a folder name.');\n  }\n  const name = value.trim();\n  if (name === '' || name.length > 100) {\n    throw badRequest('A folder name must be 1 to 100 characters.');\n  }\n  return name;\n}\n\nasync function assertOwnedFolder(client: PoolClient, userId: string, folderId: string): Promise<void> {\n  const result = await client.query('SELECT 1 FROM folders WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2', [folderId, userId]);\n  if (result.rowCount === 0) {\n    throw notFound();\n  }\n}\n\n// The folder itself plus all of its descendants.\nasync function subtreeIds(client: PoolClient, userId: string, folderId: string): Promise<string[]> {\n  const result = await client.query<{ id: string }>(\n    `WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS (\n       SELECT id FROM folders WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2\n       UNION\n       SELECT f.id FROM folders f JOIN subtree s ON f.parent_id = s.id WHERE f.user_id = $2\n     )\n     SELECT id FROM subtree`,\n    [folderId, userId]\n  );\n  return result.rows.map((row) );\n}\n\nasync function siblingIds(\n  client: PoolClient,\n  userId: string,\n  parentId: string | null,\n  excludeId: string | null\n): Promise<string[]> {\n  const result = await client.query<{ id: [userId, parentId, excludeId]\n  );\n  return result.rows.map((row) => row.id);\n}\n\nasync function renumberSiblings(client: PoolClient, userId: string, parentId: string | null): Promise<void> {\n  await writePositions(client, userId, await siblingIds(client, userId, parentId, null));\n}\n\nasync function loadFolder(userId: string, folderId: string): Promise<FolderRow> {\n  const result = await row;\n}\n\nfoldersRouter.get(\n  '/folders',\n  asyncHandler(async (_req, res) => {\n    const result = await query<FolderRow>(\n      `${FOLDER_SELECT} WHERE f.user_id = $1 ORDER BY f.position, f.created_at, f.id`,\n      [userIdOf(res)]\n    );\n    res.json({ folders: result.rows.map(mapFolder) });\n  })\n);\n\nfoldersRouter.post(\n  '/folders',\n  asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {\n    const userId = userIdOf(res);\n    const body = bodyRecord(req.body);\n    const name = cleanName(body.name);\n    const parentId =\n      body.parentId === undefined || body.parentId === null ? null inserted = await client.query<{ id: string }>(\n        `INSERT INTO folders (user_id, parent_id, name, position)\n         SELECT $1, $2::uuid, $3,\n                COALESCE((SELECT max(position) + 1 FROM folders\n                           WHERE user_id = $1 AND parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2::uuid), 0)\n         RETURNING id`,\n        [userId, parentId, name]\n      );\n      return inserted.rows[0].id;\n    });\n    res.status(201).json(mapFolder(await loadFolder(userId, id)));\n  })\n);\n\nfoldersRouter.patch(\n  '/folders/:id',\n  asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {\n    const userId = userIdOf(res);\n    const folderId = requireUuid(req.params.id);\n    const body = bodyRecord(req.body);\n\n    const name = body.name === undefined ? undefined : cleanName(body.name);\n    let requestedParent: string | null | undefined;\n    if (body.parentId !== undefined) {\n      requestedParent = body.parentId === null ? null : requireUuid(body.parentId);\n    }\n    let position: position must be a non-negative whole number.');\n      }\n      position = body.position;\n    }\n\n    await withTransaction(async (client) => {\n      const current = await client.query<{ parent_id: string | null }>(\n        'SELECT parent_id FROM folders WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2 FOR UPDATE',\n        [folderId, userId]\n      );\n      if (current.rowCount === 0) {\n        throw notFound();\n      }\n      const oldParent = current.rows[0].parent_id;\n      const newParent = requestedParent === undefined ? oldParent : requestedParent;\n      const parentChanged = newParent !== oldParent;\n\n      if (parentChanged && newParent) {\n        await assertOwnedFolder(client, userId, newParent);\n        const subtree = await subtreeIds(client, userId, folderId);\n        if (subtree.includes(newParent)) {\n          throw badRequest('A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.');\n        }\n      }\n\n      await client.query(\n        'UPDATE folders SET name = COALESCE($3, name), parent_id = $4 WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2',\n        [folderId, userId, name ?? null, newParent]\n      );\n\n      if (parentChanged || position !== ids.splice(at, 0, folderId);\n        await writePositions(client, userId, ids);\n        if (parentChanged) {\n          await renumberSiblings(client, userId, oldParent);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    res.json(mapFolder(await loadFolder(userId, folderId)));\n  })\n);\n\nfoldersRouter.delete(\n  '/folders/:id',\n  asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {\n    const userId = userIdOf(res);\n    const folderId = requireUuid(req.params.id);\n    const mode = queryString(req.query.notes);\n    const targetText = queryString(req.query.targetFolderId);\n    if (mode !== undefined && mode !== AND user_id = $2 FOR UPDATE',\n        [folderId, userId]\n      );\n      if (current.rowCount === 0) {\n        throw notFound();\n      }\n      const ids = await subtreeIds(client, userId, IS NULL`,\n        [userId, ids]\n      );\n      const affected = counted.rows[0].count;\n\n      if (targetId) {\n        await assertOwnedFolder(client, userId, targetId);\n        if throw badRequest('Choose what to do with the notes in this folder.');\n        }\n        if (mode === 'move' && !targetId) {\n          throw badRequest('Choose a folder to move the notes to.');\n        }\n        await client.query(\n          `UPDATE notes SET folder_id = $3\n            WHERE user_id = $1 AND folder_id = ANY($2::uuid[]) AND trashed_at IS NULL`,\n          [userId, ids, mode === 'move' ? targetId : null]\n        );\n      }\n\n      await client.query('DELETE FROM folders WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2', [folderId, userId]);\n      await renumberSiblings(client, userId, relative to /api.\nexport const tagsRouter = Router();\n\nexport const TAG_COLORS = ['gray', 'red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'green', 'blue', 'purple', 'pink'] as const;\n\ninterface TagRow {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  color: string;\n  note_count: number;\n}\n\nconst TAG_SELECT = `\n  SELECT t.id, t.name, t.color,\n         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM note_tags nt\n            JOIN notes n ON n.id = nt.note_id AND n.user_id = t.user_id\n           WHERE nt.tag_id = t.id AND n.trashed_at IS NULL) AS note_count\n    FROM tags t`;\n\nfunction mapTag(row: TagRow) {\n  return { id: row.id, name: row.name, color: row.color, noteCount: row.note_count };\n}\n\nfunction cleanName(value: unknown): string {\n  if (typeof value !== 'string') {\n    throw badRequest('Enter a tag name.');\n  }\n  const name = value.trim();\n  if (name === '' || name.length > 50) {\n    throw badRequest('A tag name must be 1 to 50 characters.');\n  }\n  return name;\n}\n\nfunction cleanColor(value: unknown): string {\n  const match = TAG_COLORS.find((color) => color === value);\n  if (!match) {\n    throw badRequest('Choose one of the available tag colors.');\n  }\n  return match;\n}\n\nasync function assertNameFree(userId: string, name: string, exceptId: string | null): Promise<void> {\n  const clash = await query(\n    `SELECT 1 FROM tags\n      WHERE user_id = $1 AND lower(name) = lower($2) AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR id <> $3::uuid)`,\n    [userId, name, exceptId]\n  );\n  if ((clash.rowCount ?? 0) > 0) {\n    throw conflict(`A tag named ${name} already exists.`, 'tag_exists');\n  }\n}\n\nasync function loadTag(userId: string, tagId: string): Promise<TagRow> {\n  const result = await query<TagRow>(`${TAG_SELECT} WHERE t.id = $1 AND t.user_id = $2`, [tagId, userId]);\n  const row = result.rows[0];\n  if (!row) {\n    throw notFound();\n  }\n  return row;\n}\n\ntagsRouter.get(\n  '/tags',\n  asyncHandler(async (_req, res) => {\n    const result = await query<TagRow>(`${TAG_SELECT} WHERE t.user_id = $1 ORDER BY lower(t.name), t.id`, [\n      userIdOf(res),\n    ]);\n    res.json({ tags: result.rows.map(mapTag) });\n  })\n);\n\ntagsRouter.post(\n  '/tags',\n  asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {\n    const userId = userIdOf(res);\n    const body = bodyRecord(req.body);\n    const name = cleanName(body.name);\n    const color = body.color === undefined ? RETURNING id',\n      [userId, name, color]\n    );\n    res.status(201).json(mapTag(await loadTag(userId, inserted.rows[0].id)));\n  })\n);\n\ntagsRouter.patch(\n  '/tags/:id',\n  asyncHandler(async name, tagId);\n    }\n    await query(\n      'UPDATE tags SET name = COALESCE($3, name), color = COALESCE($4, color) WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2',\n      [tagId, userId, name, color]\n    );\n    res.json(mapTag(await loadTag(userId, tagId)));\n  })\n);\n\ntagsRouter.delete(\n  '/tags/:id',\n  asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {\n    const userId = userIdOf(res);\n    const tagId =      userId,\n      ]);\n      if (owned.rowCount === 0) {\n        throw notFound();\n      }\n      await client.query('DELETE FROM note_tags WHERE tag_id = $1 AND user_id = $2', [tagId, userId]);\n      await client.query('DELETE FROM tags WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2', [tagId, userId]);\n    });\n    res.status(204).end();\n  })\n);\n"},{"path":"backend/src/features/search/routes.ts","action":"add","content":"import { Router } from 'express';\nimport { query } from '../../lib/db.js';\nimport { asyncHandler, badRequest, requireUuid } from '../../lib/errors.js';\nimport { userIdOf } from '../../lib/requireAuth.js';\nimport { FOLDER_JOIN, SUMMARY_COLUMNS, mapSummary, parseDateParam, queryString } from '../notes/repository.js';\nimport type { SummaryRow } from '../notes/repository.js';\n\n// Paths are relative to /api.\nexport const searchRouter = Router();\n\nconst RESULT_LIMIT = 50;\nconst MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 500;\n\n// U+0002 and U+0003 wrap each match so the client can build highlight elements itself.\nconst HEADLINE_OPTIONS = 'StartSel=\\u0002, StopSel=\\u0003, MaxFragments=2, MaxWords=30, MinWords=12, ShortWord=2';\n\nsearchRouter.get(\n  '/search',\n  asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {\n    const userId = userIdOf(res);\n    const text = (queryString(req.query.q) ?? '').trim().slice(0, MAX_QUERY_LENGTH);\n    const folderId = queryString(req.query.folderId);\n    const tagId = queryString(req.query.tagId);\n    const from = queryString(req.query.from);\n    const to = queryString(req.query.to);\n    const dateField = queryString(req.query.dateField);\n    const archived = queryString(req.query.archived);\n    const hasAttachments = queryString(req.query.hasAttachments);\n\n    if (dateField !== undefined && dateField !== '' && dateField !== 'updated' && dateField !== 'created') {\n      throw badRequest('Invalid query parameter.');\n    }\n    if (archived !== undefined && archived !== '' && archived !== 'only') {\n      throw badRequest('Invalid query parameter.');\n    }\n    const folder = folderId ? requireUuid(folderId) : null;\n    const tag = tagId ? requireUuid(tagId) : null;\n    const fromDate = from ? parseDateParam(from) : null;\n    const toDate = to ? parseDateParam(to) : null;\n\n    if (text === '') {\n      res.json({ results: [] });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const params: unknown[] = [userId, text, HEADLINE_OPTIONS];\n    const add = (value: unknown): string => {\n      params.push(value);\n      return `$${params.length}`;\n    };\n\n    const where = [\n      'n.user_id = $1',\n      'n.trashed_at IS NULL',\n      archived === 'only' ? 'n.is_archived = true' : 'n.is_archived = false',\n      'numnode(q.tsq) > 0',\n      'n.search_vector @@ q.tsq',\n    ];\n    if (folder) {\n      where.push(`n.folder_id = ${add(folder)}`);\n    }\n    if (tag) {\n      where.push(\n        `EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note_tags nt WHERE nt.note_id = n.id AND nt.user_id = n.user_id AND nt.tag_id = ${add(\n          tag\n        )})`\n      );\n    }\n    const dateColumn = dateField === 'created' ? 'n.created_at' : 'n.updated_at';\n    if (fromDate) {\n      where.push(`${dateColumn} >= ${add(fromDate)}::date`);\n    }\n    if (toDate) {\n      where.push(`${dateColumn} < (${add(toDate)}::date + 1)`);\n    }\n    if (hasAttachments === 'true') {\n      where.push('EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attachments a WHERE a.note_id = n.id AND a.user_id = n.user_id)');\n    }\n\n    // OD-007: ts_rank descending, then most recently updated. Snippets are built only for\n    // the limited hit set, and only when the body text itself matches.\n    const result = await query<SummaryRow & { snippet: string | null }>(\n      `WITH q AS (\n         SELECT websearch_to_tsquery('english', $2::text) || websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $2::text) AS tsq\n       ),\n       hits AS (\n         SELECT n.id, ts_rank(n.search_vector, q.tsq) AS score\n           FROM notes n CROSS JOIN q\n          WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}\n          ORDER BY score DESC, n.updated_at DESC, n.id\n          LIMIT ${RESULT_LIMIT}\n       )\n       SELECT ${SUMMARY_COLUMNS},\n              CASE\n                WHEN n.body_text <> '' AND to_tsvector('english', n.body_text) @@ q.tsq\n                  THEN ts_headline('english', n.body_text, q.tsq, $3::text)\n                WHEN n.body_text <> '' AND to_tsvector('simple', n.body_text) @@ q.tsq\n                  THEN ts_headline('simple', n.body_text, q.tsq, $3::text)\n                ELSE NULL\n              END AS snippet\n         FROM hits h\n         JOIN notes n ON n.id = h.id\n         CROSS JOIN q\n         ${FOLDER_JOIN}\n        ORDER BY h.score DESC, n.updated_at DESC, n.id`,\n      params\n    );\n\n    res.json({\n      results: result.rows.map((row) => ({ ...mapSummary(row), snippet: row.snippet })),\n    });\n  })\n);\n"},{"path":"backend/src/features/trash/purge.ts","action":"add","content":"import { query } from '../../lib/db.js';\nimport { deleteFile } from '../../lib/storage.js';\n\nconst DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS = 30;\nconst DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MINUTES = 60;\n\nfunction envPositive(name: string, fallback: number): number {\n  const value = Number(process.env[name]);\n  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;\n}\n\nexport function trashRetentionSeconds(): number {\n  return envPositive('TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS', DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS) * 24 * 60 *
